description.en: A Paleocene fertile shoot has opposite leaves and paired reproductive structures.
description.zh: 古新世育性枝具对生叶及成对生殖结构。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Metasequoia foxii, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Metasequoia foxii 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Opposite/decussate leaf and cone organization is the diagnostic specimen feature, distinct from the existing generic conifer canopy.
distinctness.zh: 叶与球果的对生交互排列是诊断标本特征，区别于现有普通针叶树冠。

modeling_brief.en: Lay out a small flat spray with explicitly paired attachments; emphasize topology rather than a full redwood outline.
modeling_brief.zh: 建立明确成对着生的小型扁枝，强调拓扑而非完整红杉轮廓。

uncertainty: Specimen-scale utility is essential; do not add a whole-tree duplicate or claim preserved bark colour.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.
